items.name: c-bubble-1
items.title: Support thread with sender alignment
items.description: A two sided billing thread where align and variant carry the sender.
items.descriptionLong: Support thread with sender alignment. Built by composing Avatar, Bubble, Card. A free, open source shadcn bubble example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-bubble-1 and edit as your own code.

items.title: Bubble variants in a release thread
